changelog: Fixes a channel built from series showing nothing but "Sendepause": episodes filed under season 0 were dropped, and a library where that is where the episodes sit left the channel with nothing to play. Specials now air where their metadata says they belong - between the episodes they were made for - instead of being skipped. Scheduling grew up: program blocks give a part of the week its own lineup and its own weekdays, programs can start on a fixed grid so a block can promise the film at 20:15, a queue can be shuffled once and for good, and the time a slot leaves over is filled with trailers for what is coming up. The guide is now a real time grid, and the channels can be published to Jellyfin's own Live TV section so native clients get a schedule too.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
